companionInventory.limitation: This binds the retained archive catalogue packet, not a claim about every file ever published elsewhere. Original packet contains a general single-sided answer-sheet instruction but no separate native answer-sheet pages beyond its actual ten pages.

sourceGaps: All six available original worked keys are fully retained, including alternate methods and grading commentary. Complete source transcription does not certify mathematical correctness of printed key.
No per-subpart numeric scoring allocations are provided; source whole-problem25/50 point values and A1full-credit edge cases retained.

Original question/key dates differ between supervisor and student security instructions; source dates retained. Native unique key supervisor pagination retained as separate documentNote while other repeated administrative/repeated task prose is normalized to one public occurrence.
No actual blank graph/answer sheets occur in these retained PDFs despite the supervisor single-sided sheet instruction; no new sheet synthesized. Source native figures/photos all retained.

Question unlettered common continuations after A2(a) and A3(b) remain statementAfter of preceding part, in native source order. B1(a) retains both roman leaves; B1(b)/(c)/(d) remain native leaf section statements. No original whole problem is split.
Printed formula/wording defects remain native text/math with explicit sourceContradictions, no invented correction or substitute answer.

sourceContradictions.description: Supervisor says questions may be returned afterApril15,2017; student cover permits communication afterApril8,2017. Both exact native dates retained.

Second geometric method calls phi the angle between vertical and plane normal, then uses it in friction bound |theta-beta|<=phi; it also gives amin=0 for tan(theta)<=mu while the first method says minimum applied force zero with a=F/(3m)-mu*g. Strict versus non-strict inequalities and both minimum statements remain as printed.

Printed E=hc/lambda=0.00112eV is retained alongside original question lambda=1.06mm and native constants h/c; their numeric evaluation does not give that printed value. No recalculated value substituted.
Printed tangential symbol B_theta differs from earlier B_phi. Actual native B_b=-2B_theta proportional sin(phi) proportional cos(theta) retained; no subscript silently corrected.

Native upper-corner equations print h(1-cos(phi+alpha)) approximately h and h(1-cos(phi+beta))+t sin(phi+beta) approximately h+t(phi+beta), inconsistent small-angle limits. The text says total potential energy is minimized for beta_max while next paragraph calls it maximum. All printed statements/formulas preserved.

Intermediate half-angle relation tan(theta/2)=b/r retained. Final native numerator printed tan theta/2 without parentheses is preserved as printed, alongside0.0894T; this typography is ambiguous rather than editorially rewritten.
Native time-constant parenthesis is unclosed; native wording calls500kV a steady charge. Both preserved rather than quietly changing syntax/physical quantity.
Combined resistance expression uses rho/d rather than preceding d_o notation; literal d denominator and0.079Ohm retained.
Flow-rate numerator uses I²Nr without subscript s after earlier r_s. Specific heat capacity wording in liters retained. No missing subscript invented.
